explanation: Every vector with at most rho nonzero entries is the image of a pair (positions c : Fin rho -> Option (Fin N), values v : Fin rho -> F) under g(c, v)(j) = sum of v_i over i with c_i = some j: embed the support into Fin rho and put the values there. Hence f o g is onto T, and |T| <= (N+1)^rho |F|^rho.
